name: How long does it take to install garage floor tiles?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install garage floor tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of garage floor tile installation depends on the garage size, tile type, and complexity of the preparation work. A standard two-car garage with interlocking PVC tiles might take one to two days for professional installation. If extensive subfloor repairs are needed, or if opting for grouted ceramic/porcelain tiles, the project could extend to three to five days due, including cure times. We provide a clear timeline estimate after assessing your specific garage and chosen materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, with a two-car garage and interlocking tiles taking 1-2 days. More complex projects with subfloor repairs or grouted tiles may take 3-5 days.
